reasons: This is a test fixture, so it is only as reliable as the tests that use it, which were not supplied.

terms.meaning: fixed sample data that tests use as a known starting point
a record of where a value came from and how sure we are of it

sections.name: File setup, provenance
sections.title: Imports and sample source note
sections.what: Brings in the project data types and defines one shared source note that marks positions as schematic assumptions.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The note says the values are assumptions, so tests should not treat them as real measurements.

sections.name: parametricComponent
sections.title: Sample component builder
sections.what: Creates one sample component with a fixed ID pattern, a yard equipment label, fixed planned dates, a box shape and a set position.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Dates are fixed in 2026, so tests that depend on the current date may behave differently.

sections.name: parametricModel
sections.title: Sample project model builder
sections.what: Creates a full sample project with two components, a yard facility label, schedule dates and accuracy scores.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The accuracy scores are fixed, so any test that changes them must check the shown values carefully.

summary: Builds small sample project data (one model with two components) for tests that need a realistic-looking project.
purpose: Gives tests a predictable starting project so they do not need real project files.
why: Reason not stated in the code.
how: Creates one component builder with a set position and size, then builds a project model that holds two of them along with accuracy numbers.
inputs: Optional ID, width and depth values for each component.
outputs: A component object and a full project model object.
risks: The provenance text says Schematic assumption and the component builder sets fixed dates, so tests using it will not reflect real schedules.
debug: If a test using this fixture fails, check whether the expected values match these fixed sample values.
